title: Run a sed script file on text
summary: Apply a set of text editing rules stored in a script file to the output of a command. This is useful for complex or repeated text transformations.

steps.explain: Execute the sed commands stored in a script file on the output of another command and print the result to the screen.

placeholders.name: COMMAND
placeholders.description: The command that generates the text you want to process

placeholders.name: SCRIPT_FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the sed script file containing the editing rules
